reviews.text: My fur baby Supreme got hurt outside possibly defending himself. A few days later we noticed his paw was bleeding. He became very clingy and whiny. Took him here on whim. Super glad we did. The entire medical team cared for my baby. Turns out he had an abscess on his paw that was infected, and 102 temp. They treated my fur baby and (me) he scratched me up when a dog came in. I highly recommend this facility. It was cost effective and professional ❤️

The worst veterinary experience I’ve ever had.

I asked for a written prescription because Walmart offered the medication at a lower price. The clinic initially agreed, but when I arrived at Walmart, the prescription was denied. When I called the office, I was given multiple conflicting explanations. First, I was told the medication was not for dogs, even though three pharmacists confirmed that it was and the packaging clearly indicated it was for canine use. Then I was told my dog might have an allergic reaction, despite my explaining that my dog had already taken the same medication on three previous occasions without any issues. After that, I was told they simply do not recommend generic medications.

I asked several times to speak directly with the veterinarian. I was told he was at lunch, but I could hear him speaking in the background while the receptionist relayed messages instead of allowing me to discuss my concerns with him directly.

What was most frustrating is that when I originally requested the prescription, I specifically told the staff I was taking it to Walmart. Instead of explaining their concerns about Walmart’s generic medication at that time, they wrote the prescription. Only after I tried to fill it did they refuse to authorize it. When I asked why no one had informed me earlier, I was told they “didn’t want to make me feel uncomfortable.” That explanation made no sense because this was important information that should have been communicated before I left the office.

The entire situation involved poor communication, inconsistent explanations, and unprofessional customer service. I left feeling frustrated, inconvenienced, and unable to have an honest conversation with the veterinarian about my dog’s care. I expect better communication and professionalism from a veterinary team, especially when it comes to decisions affecting a pet’s medication. And still no medication.

Our experience coming to this hospital was really great. They saved our dog’s life and we are extremely grateful. Her uterus was extremely swollen full of puss. She is healing at the moment from her surgery, but is becoming more active as the days pass. Can’t wait for our Cookie to go back to her usual self. Thank you for your services.
Excellent service

West Side Animal Hospital took amazing care of my 2-year-old cat during her surgery. The entire staff was kind, compassionate, and made me feel at ease throughout the whole process. They explained everything clearly, answered all of my questions, and made sure I knew how to help my cat recover at home. I'm so grateful for the excellent care they provided and highly recommend them!

Terrible customer service, took my dog on May 11th for vaccinations and now that I am requesting vaccinations records they have no documentation of my dog getting his vaccines meanwhile I have both the bank charge and the booklet & rabies paperwork to prove that he indeed got vaccinated there on May 11th 2026

We have been using the West Side Animal Clinic for three years and we can always count on professional care for our dog, starting with standard vaccinations, dental care, and finally, diagnosis of the disease and making the right diagnosis based on correctly read laboratory tests by Dr. Luke and implementation of appropriate medical treatment! (A week ago - our corgi was put on all fours 😊). Also the entire team of people working there - starting from the registration (front desk), the lady providing information, to the lovely and helpful Mrs. Natalie ❤️, who has a professional approach to each animal and is available to help "Polish-speaking" patients 🇵🇱🤗
always a good experience..takes care of my puppy no complaints

My cat Miss Pepper Potts needed her anal glands expressed. They were infected (she's a prolific licker) and she was running a temperature. For under $300 my baby was sedated, had her glands expressed and the infection drained. She received her annual rabies shot, 7 days of antibiotics pills. They took care of her.  This is the second time they saved my baby.  No frills, just good inexpensive vet care.
I feel SO confident that, when I do call them, they will be so happy to give me that dog park pass.

I am extremely disappointed with my experience at this animal hospital. From my perspective, it felt like money was prioritized over the well-being of my dog. We spent a significant amount on visits, tests, and treatments, yet my dog's condition was not properly diagnosed. As a result, his health has continued to decline, and we are now dealing with serious issues that should have been addressed sooner.

The communication was frustrating, and I left feeling that my concerns were not taken seriously. When you trust a veterinary clinic with a beloved family member, you expect compassion, careful attention, and accurate medical care. Unfortunately, that was not my experience.

I would not recommend this hospital based on what happened with my dog. Pet owners deserve transparency, empathy, and confidence that their animal's health comes first.

This was one of the worst experiences I have ever had at a veterinary clinic. From the moment I walked in, I was treated with a shocking lack of professionalism and basic courtesy. The woman at the front desk was openly rude, confrontational, and dismissive. Instead of helping address concerns, she spoke in a manner that felt hostile and unnecessarily aggressive, creating a stressful and uncomfortable environment.
My interaction with Dr. Chaudhry was equally disappointing. I left feeling that my concerns were not taken seriously and that there was very little effort made to communicate clearly or provide reassurance regarding my pet's care. The entire appointment felt rushed, impersonal, and lacking the compassion that pet owners reasonably expect when seeking medical attention for a beloved animal.
What was most troubling was the overall atmosphere of the clinic. Rather than feeling supported during what can already be an emotional situation, I felt unwelcome and frustrated throughout the visit. Respectful communication and professionalism should be the minimum standard in any healthcare setting, and in my experience, those standards were not met here.
I would not return to this clinic and would strongly encourage other pet owners to carefully consider their options before scheduling an appointment if you love your Pet!!!!

I had a very disappointing experience at this veterinary clinic. The staff seemed rushed and inattentive, and I felt like my concerns about my pet were not taken seriously. Communication was poor throughout the visit, and it was difficult to get clear answers about treatment options and costs.
The appointment felt disorganized, with long wait times despite having a scheduled appointment. I also felt pressured into additional services without a thorough explanation of why they were necessary. Overall, the level of care and customer service did not meet my expectations, and I left feeling frustrated and uncertain about the care my pet received.
Based on my experience, I would not recommend this clinic and will be seeking veterinary care elsewhere in the future.

My Aunt took her dog here that had elevated liver and kidney enzymes and was not eating and all they told her was to put her dog down. They also precribed carprofen which is a pain med that can damage the liver and kidneys even more, my aunt transferred her care to VEG where she got fluids, an antibiotic and a liver supplement, anti nausea meds and is finally stable and eating. The receptionist is also rude and incompetent, I don’t know how these people are in business! These practice is horrible do not take your pets here!

It is really sad that in the Black community we still struggle with getting good customer service. I should not feel like I have to travel outside my community and pay more somewhere else just to be treated with kindness and respect during an emergency situation. Very disappointing
I have been going here for a long time and they are all asewome. They take great care of my huskies and now my poodle malrltese sky. I always recommended ppl to go there. Go check it out.

I found the Delta location on Chicago Ave first in 2011/2012. March of 2026 my 15yr old cat took her last breath. Since I was closer to West side animal hospital, that is where I trusted the vet and staff for the cremation. And let me just say, I was having such a hard time loosing my cat, and the receptionist was so empathetic. She consoled me with her politeness. And comforted me with reassurances that my cat was in safe hands and would be handled with care.

West Side Animal hospital is a great place. I definitely recommend!!

I bring here my 3 years of female Doberman  with dr Luka for  ear crop , they did Great , her ears are perfect , decide to get a second Doberman I bring her with th same dr  and she got the worst cropped 😔  I really don’t see the way  to get her fix , I don’t want her to go to the process again , …
Took my 2 dogs. Professional and friendly. Prices are reasonable.
quick service good prices
Great experience, quality care and reasonable prices.

Thank you so much for taking care of Sky in such a short time notice. The doctor was able to stitch her up and left us with meds and a cream. I really appreciate him and his staff for going above and beyond. Can’t recommend enough!

I was referred by a coworker. My dog became Il suddenly and I didn’t think twice to take her to the vet! They predicted Pyometra we did blood work got results the next day her white blood count was high so yes he was correct we scheduled the surgery and everything went well thankfully came back for her stitches to be out and shots I had a pleasant experience &’ I’ve been referring friends and family here! Now my baby is back to her normal self ❤️
The service here is wonderful they have been there for years and very caring as well as reasonably priced!

The employees at West Side Animal Hospital are very caring professional and courteous.  We have been taking our dogs here for a while and they do a great service. The prices are very affordable.  We wanted to personally say thank you to Natalia Soldra for always taking care of us when we visit. Highly recommended.

Been bringing my dogs here for years and never had any problems but it’s a young black girl receptionist there now that’s so unprofessional. She has a very bad attitude and rude. If she can’t work well with the public, she needs to find another job before someone snaps out on her. I miss the Russian lady that use to work the front desk. Please train the young lady how to Talk to customers

I don't have pets... But I found a dog, and needed to know if he was chipped.  They were friendly,  a young woman was at the desk and promptly checked the chip, gave me the read out and then helped me find the providers info.  It took a lil longer than usual to find it, but she didn't stop trying to help me. By the 3rd time she found it and gave me the info.
Mr Willie came out from in back, heard the situation and saw that I had a back pack strap trying to walk him, and provided me with a leash they happened to have.
They had nothing to charge me for, but they extended their time and kindness that several oak park facilities would NOT.

I’ve been coming here for years now they have went up on their prices but they still offer less than basic services. $30 for a fee when all they do is weigh the animal $70 for shots. Called about grooming I was told $100 and all they do is shave the dog.

I couldn’t afford to take my sick cat to the vet until I found this place. Kind staff running a tight ship on low-cost animal care, it’s a clinic that I wish had more donations, funding, and locations (they do have a sister location). I will be taking my animals here again and appreciate everything they are doing for Chicagoans and our pets and people. Walk-ins are welcome but make an appointment if possible since they are busy and can only do so many appointments a day!
Stopping here to get my puppy, a haircut and his shots along with a bath and he looked so handsome when they got done with him, it was worth every penny🥰

This veterinarian is like right up the street from my house. It’s quite convenient. I’ve been going there for some years. I called there just to get some information over the phone explained it to the assistant and this woman had the nerve to say she don’t feel like being bothered or to look up my file Pass the phone to the veterinarian and I only had a question, she was rude. I am a supervisor for a well-known utility company, and that would not be acceptable.

Ive taken my pets to this Vet since 2005. I'm on my 6th dog and since Delta is ran by his daughter, this location is much closer. The fees are very reasonable compared to other vets. Although the place could use an updo for esthetics, its not important, but the care of your dog is. I hope they update their computer system for shot records to be printed, however old school still works.

First visit for my pup. The staff have the energy that’s needed when interacting with the public ( empathy, smiles, enthusiasm, great customer service), especially the young lady at the front desk with colored hair. I didn’t get her name, but she’s amazing. Very fast service, for a walk-in visit we spent an hour inside. Just from observation, I feel they should clean more often considering the high traffic. Otherwise, I feel very satisfied with our visit ☺️.
Took my puppy to get her "first time" vaccinations. Staff was very informative and helpful. I went on a weekend. Can get busy so be prepared to wait.

We have been coming to Westside Animal Hospital while Dr. P was the vet over 50 years now.  I have not had one unkind employee during my visit with my dogs. I now live in the suburbs and still take the drive because it’s still budget friendly. I want to thank the entire team for caring for our animals. God Bless!

My dog had a bad tooth ache. They got my doggie in, got my beautiful Lola
confrontable, knocked her out with meds. When I return she looks droopy and ready for a very reasonable price. Thank You Doc, you will have me as a customer as long as I have dogs. I will always have a pet dog in this LiFe 🧬🧬. …

Very honest

Dr. Luka is upfront and doesn't sugarcoat anything. He explains the problems clearly and doesn't try to overcharge you. I definitely recommend this place.

The best service from Dr. Luka and his entire staff five thumbs up i am very happy with my visit and my dogs who are on the elder site seems to have a second wind after that visit. I am so extremely happy and I will be going back to west side animal hospital for sure in the future!
Because they were understaffed on the weekend they didn't properly diagnose my dog and he eventually died a day and a half later.. worst service ever.!

Dr.Lukas is the best, he really knows what he's doing. My entire family brings their fur babies here. He has saved my dog's life and I can't even express how much I love and appreciate him ❤️. Dr. Lukas will forever be my to go guy . I've been taking my dogs here for years & you can tell how much he genuinely loves dogs. He's a blessing from the sky.
Thank you Dr. Lukas , for everything.
YEAH THEY DEFINITELY LOST MY BUSINESS

They treated us much better than in other vets we have been.
I am very satisfied with the attention.
Real scam. Unorganized dirty clinic my dog never received his blood test results

From blood on the floor, to dust and spider webs everywhere. It smelled atrocious. It hasn't been cleaned in years. The staff wasn't any better. It seriously was terrifying. I’m so grateful for a  kindness and care  provided to my lovely dog Koya,she had a surgery and I was very stressed because she is a 11 yrs old dog, and I was afraid of any complications!!
I would like to say THANK YOU TO NATALIE, for her support and professionalism wich make me feel safe and at peace !!
Thanks so much
Very fast service
Glad they're in the Community. Got my cats spayed, nuetered and shots all in one visit. Plus their nails trimmed.
